summary.zh: 查询客户、公司与销售管道
summary.en: Query CRM records and deal pipelines

description.zh: 读取公司、联系人、交易与自定义对象记录，按属性筛选并更新字段。适合在对话里查客户背景或推进商机。首次连接在浏览器登录 Attio 授权。
description.en: Read companies, people, deals, and custom object records, filter by attribute, and update fields. Useful for pulling customer context or moving a deal forward in conversation. Sign in to Attio in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Attio 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Attio and authorize on first connect
